long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in Vienna, Hallmann completed a commercial computer-science school and entered business as a teenager, trading computer components. Profits from that venture funded his first property investment, followed by the creation of a real-estate company that became Hallmann Corporate Group. He expanded from property trading into development, renovation and income-producing assets across Austria and other European markets.

The group later broadened into financial services, medical technology and entertainment, while real estate remained its central operating field. Hallmann also founded Hallmann Entertainment Company and has worked personally on dozens of films and documentaries as a producer. After moving away from the holding company's day-to-day management, he retained a founder-investor role focused on strategy and projects, combining property ownership with a diversified portfolio.
